description: TC-3443: what the SDK's generic manifest asks for when an app names no permissions. Generated from js-sdk sdk-core (genericAppId and genericAppManifest in packages/sdk-core/src/owner-access.ts, resolved by resolveManifest with the standard tier in packages/sdk-core/src/manifest.ts). OpenKey grants the same set to a delegate request with no permissions. When the SDK changes these, regenerate this file and change OpenKey to match.
